title: Eric Burlison criticizes Obamacare and calls for national application of NFA ruling
text:
Eric Burlison criticizes Obamacare and calls for national application of NFA ruling
Rep. Eric Burlison, a U.S. Congressman representing Missouri’s 7th district since 2023, recently posted a series of tweets addressing the rising costs of health insurance and advocating for Second Amendment rights.
On August 18, 2026, Burlison stated, "In 2000, the average family paid about $6,000 a year for health insurance. Today, that figure has climbed to nearly $27,000. It's more than just inflation—Obamacare is broken. It's time to put patients back in control of their healthcare. Read more https://t.co/2wsVKDohrq". In a subsequent post on the same day, he shared an additional link: https://t.co/cGzUJVoScQ.
The following day, on August 19, 2026, Burlison addressed gun rights in another tweet: "Americans shouldn't be deprived of their Second Amendment rights simply because of where they live or who they buy from. The DOJ must take steps to apply the landmark NFA ruling nationwide. No tax, no registration. Simple as that."
Burlison has served in Congress since replacing Billy Long in 2023 and previously held seats in both the Missouri House of Representatives (2009-2017) and Missouri Senate (2019-2023). He was born in Springfield, Missouri, in 1976 and currently resides in Ozark. Burlison graduated from Missouri State University with degrees earned in both 2000 and 2002.
